verdict.rationale: The platform's agents run autonomously in the background. Kosmos executes complete research workflows on its own (reading literature, running code, producing reports). The client also supports asynchronous task submission, where you submit many jobs and retrieve results later, plus long-lived sessions that persist across turns. However, nothing documents setting up persistent automations: there are no schedules, recurring runs, event triggers or completion callbacks, so any repeated or triggered execution would have to be driven by the user's own scripts. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automation setup, event-based triggers, completion notifications/webhooks, independent hands-on corroboration.
